cell.name: CorrespondenceCell
cell.instancing: one cell per relationship; opaque globally unique id; never a scaffold-local sequence
cell.reuses: ChatCell machinery: ChatMessage value, ContentCryptoSuite envelopes, invitation artifacts and ledger, membership fingerprint and rekey, flow emission
cell.responsibility: Relationship-scoped enveloped message exchange between domain-scoped identities, operator-blind for identity and content.

security.umbrellaGrantNote: ChatCell.canRead/canWrite fall back to the 'chat' keypath. CorrespondenceCell never consults an umbrella keypath; every action is checked at its own keypath only.
security.keysOnScaffold: none that open content; envelopes are prepared and opened in the requester's IdentityVault
security.memberIdentityScope: correspondence-domain Identity per participant (Chapter 03 §2); mapping to person is never stored on the hosting scaffold

cannotSee: any link from identity UUID to a person
operatorVisibility.notClaimed: traffic pattern (volume, timing, size) is not hidden; no package text may imply unobservability

externalAgreementTemplate.note: Exactly these grants for any external surface (MCP, HTTP adapter). Nothing else is ever issued to an external surface.

grants.returns: outer envelope metadata for messages addressed to requester: messageID, sequence, senderIdentityUUID, purposeRef, createdAt, expiresAt, ciphertextSize, receiptState

grants.why_action: reading is a recorded deliberate act; an r--- grant on history would make it silent

input.receipt: recipient-signed statement encrypted to sender (target); pilot may accept bare ack

ownerAgreement.note: Owner identity of a relationship holds membership and lifecycle; issued separately from the external template and never to an MCP process.

outer.retention: none of its own; deleted together with inner at expiresAt

inner.signature: sender Identity signs inner before encryption

retention.senderMay: shorten within policy; lengthen only up to cell maximum
retention.expiryDeletes: outer and inner together; never body-only

delegatedEntity.definition: Chapter 32 §1: capability-bearing runtime identity the owner approved for a bounded purpose
requires: enrollment record linking to delegating owner Identity with purpose, expiry, revocationRef
delegation reference carried in inner envelope
recipient verifies sender signature AND delegation
delegatedEntity.revocation: withdraws delegation; preserves Identity and history

rules: invokes cell actions; never defines semantic success
envelopes prepared and opened locally against IdentityVault
MCP config grants nothing; Agreement is the authority
message content never authorizes local code or machine action

hosting.pilot: shared staging scaffold; operator blind for identity and content per security.operatorVisibility
hosting.target: participant-hosted home scaffold (Chapter 32 §3) with cross-scaffold Resolver routing; no shared operator
hosting.constraint: no outer field may assume both parties on one scaffold

migration: AssistantCorrespondence* contracts remain only as HTTP adapter wire format where an adapter persists; they stop being the storage model
AssistantCorrespondenceGrant replaced by Agreement from externalAgreementTemplate; allowedPeerIDs -> membership, allowedOperations -> four grants, allowedPurposeRefs -> cell purpose policy
existing plaintext messages are not migrated; retained under current policy until expiry
testRequirements: scaffold-side dump of a cell shows no plaintext content or subject
Resolver refuses audience.inviteIdentities under the external Agreement
scaffold state for a cell holds member identity UUIDs and no displayName, principal label, or entityRef
expiry removes outer row and inner ciphertext together
delegated assistant sends; recipient verifies signature and delegation reference
signed client notarized, stapled, Gatekeeper pass
openQuestions: delegation reference also in Agreement signed commit so Resolver refuses revoked delegation pre-storage (implementation reports)

decisions.twoMemberMembershipChange: close cell, emit cell.closed; new relationship = new cell
decisions.perCounterpartyProfiles: superseded by one delegated identity with many peers; not renamed
